title: Terra: a frozen full-suite geospatial system evaluation

protocol.attemptPolicy: First valid primary attempt; verified infrastructure replacements only. Supplemental timeouts are separate.

adaptiveConcurrency.policy: Admission adjusted to available resources and provider health.

protocol.humanAssistance: Scripted fixture provisioning and exact fixture-scoped approvals; no analytical coaching. Qualitative rubrics reviewed by the Codex evaluation operator (AI-assisted), not blinded.
adaptations: Each measured task has 40 minutes, including queues and processing.
Independent artifact grading instead of GeoBenchX tool-trace matching.
Exact frozen editions and strict thresholds are explicit.
Source row identity is explicit because upstream business IDs repeat.
Snowfall coverage is explicitly qualified; unknown cells are not zero snowfall.
Country identity uses verified source codes; the released name-only reference misses four African names.
Selected-feature artifact and machine-readable final count/coverage are requested to make correctness auditable.

Automatic approval uses the normal profile-accessible processors and fixture-only proven lineage within the declared task. No live-data substitutes, unrelated scope, arbitrary code, operator coaching, or silent reruns are allowed. Exact-workflow authorization and application safety rules remain enforced.
Algeria population density uses the supplied 2020 density grid and containing-pixel sampling; unknown cells are reported separately.

Recent earthquakes means all events in the frozen supplied snapshot labelled Feb142025, with observed UTC event times January 16–February 15, 2025; county intersects and station within conventions are explicit.
Amtrak unknown_count excludes stations outside supplied county coverage; that distinction is explicit in the submitted prompt.
Original questions, source editions and missing-value conventions were fixed before measurement.
Numeric-answer tasks additionally require an inspectable contributing-feature artifact and a final JSON object; this is an evaluation adaptation, not the original benchmark's tool-trace grader.
Comparisons use unweighted country means, the supplied country classification, and explicit years; no population-weighted substitution or current live data.
Country-map family: frozen year/indicator, exact ISO_A3 join, complete unknown coverage, five quantile classes and inspectable map binding; independently verified values and legend.
Contour family: disclosed levels and original-grid marching-square geometry; verified complete isolines and actual map/overlay bindings.
Bivariate family: frozen years, exact joins and paired three-quantile joint classification; numerical values and actual legend independently verified.
Country-change selections: explicitly frozen multi-year definitions and strict thresholds, exact source IDs and unknown-location accounting.

Heatmap family: fixed 25 km equal-area EPSG:6933 cells, 150 km three-sigma Gaussian radius, declared count or numeric weights; metric raster adaptation replaces screen-pixel heatmaps and is exhaustively checked against independent binning/convolution.
Map series: independently checked years, full original feature coverage, per-year classifications and distinct authoritative map bindings; no single-panel substitution.
County public-health maps: frozen public county aggregates, exact state-qualified joins, disclosed quantitative map or geometric-centroid heatmap; no individual patient locations inferred.

Population-density shares: derive density from original count rasters and ellipsoidal cell areas, retain original grid/masks and independently verify every output cell and final total. These capability cases extend archived refusal references, not claim matching those refusals.
protocol.measurement: One valid selected primary, with complete physical-attempt and incident accounting.

limitations: Tasks were used during development; this is not a held-out test or a causal comparison.
Different tools, budgets and independent artifact grading prevent direct comparison with published GeoBenchX scores.
Setup-blocked and infrastructure-unmeasured questions remain visible in coverage, outside valid-measurement accuracy.
Bulk input and output datasets remain private; full reconstruction requires the documented source prerequisites.
Dollar costs are unavailable. Qualitative judgments use AI-assisted operator review and are not blinded or an external audit.

incidents.explanation: The external model connection ended the agent turn before it could continue or publish. Completed processor artifacts and original failures remain preserved; none are scored as successes.
incidents.applicabilityRule: Every primary run with a durable terminal run.failed event in [07:00:00,07:02:00] UTC on 2026-10-07 carrying agent_provider_unavailable and httpConnectionFailed is invalidated, independent of artifacts or grader outcome. Recovered ordinary backoff and intact runs without terminal transport exhaustion remain valid under the frozen policy.

exampleSelection: First computational pass in task-ID order with a recorded trial and assessment (otherwise first computational pass); first valid computational nonpass. Illustrative, not representative of every task.
